name: Fauvism
garments: not a fashion look — a painting movement

media.title: Henri Matisse, Woman with a Hat (1905)
media.note: the painting most associated with the 1905 scandal

reacts_against: naturalistic color entirely — Fauvist painters used color expressively rather than descriptively (a face could be painted green), which is what provoked the critic Louis Vauxcelles to call the room "les fauves" (the wild beasts).

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Simplified forms, flattened perspective, vigorous brushwork, landscapes, portraits
wiki_facts.key_colours: Intense, pure, non-naturalistic colors, often applied directly from the tube; strong and dissonant color contrasts
wiki_facts.key_values: Emotional expression through color, separation of color from descriptive reality, painterly spontaneity

findings: a vivid streak — roughly 27% of the color measured is highly saturated
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
